key: CIEL: Ah, \PN, you're just in time,
en: CIEL: Ah, \PN, you're just in time,
ja: シエル: あら、\PN、ちょうどいいところに来ましたわね、

key: ... is what I would say if there were anything to be in time for.
en: ... is what I would say if there were anything to be in time for.
ja: ……と言いたいところですけど、間に合うべき何かがあれば、の話ですわ。

key: But folks always are saying things like that, aren't they?
en: But folks always are saying things like that, aren't they?
ja: でも、こういうことって、みんなよく言うものですものね。

key: SAMSON: Meteor's a dud.
en: SAMSON: Meteor's a dud.
ja: サムソン: メテオはハズレだったな。

key: CIEL: Rather.
en: CIEL: Rather.
ja: シエル: ええ、まったく。

key: We were summoned up here on the pretense that this was Team Meteor's titular space rock.
en: We were summoned up here on the pretense that this was Team Meteor's titular space rock.
ja: ここに呼ばれたのは、チームメテオの名を冠したあの宇宙の岩だという話だったからですわ。

key: It appears that is not so.
en: It appears that is not so.
ja: どうやら、そうではなかったようですけれど。

key: SAMSON: "Team Space Rock" almost sounds cooler though...
en: SAMSON: "Team Space Rock" almost sounds cooler though...
ja: サムソン: 「チーム宇宙の岩」の方が、なんかカッコいい気もするけどな……

key: CIEL: It doesn't.
en: CIEL: It doesn't.
ja: シエル: しませんわ。

key: Terra said the original meteor should be sealed in crystal, but there's not a speck of crystal here to be found.
en: Terra said the original meteor should be sealed in crystal, but there's not a speck of crystal here to be found.
ja: テラの話では、本物のメテオはクリスタルに封じられているはずだそうですけれど、ここにはクリスタルのかけらすら見当たりませんわ。

key: We can only assume that this is some other, run-of- the-mill brand meteor.
en: We can only assume that this is some other, run-of- the-mill brand meteor.
ja: つまり、これはどこにでもあるような、ありきたりのいん石だと考えるしかありませんわね。

key: SAMSON: To be fair, she also said it was covered in several other things, such as rubber Duckletts, and glycerin-free lube.
en: SAMSON: To be fair, she also said it was covered in several other things, such as rubber Duckletts, and glycerin-free lube.
ja: サムソン: まあ公平に言うと、テラはこれがゴム製のコアルヒーとか、グリセリン不使用のローションとか、他にもいろいろで覆われてるって言ってたけどな。

key: CIEL: Yes.
en: CIEL: Yes.
ja: シエル: ええ。

key: I am choosing to ignore all of those things, thank you.
en: I am choosing to ignore all of those things, thank you.
ja: そのあたりのことは全部、聞かなかったことにしますわ、どうも。

key: All in all, this is an utter let down.
en: All in all, this is an utter let down.
ja: とにかく、まったくもってがっかりですわ。

key: SAMSON: I was looking forward to knocking Lin's skull for what she did back in Agate too.
en: SAMSON: I was looking forward to knocking Lin's skull for what she did back in Agate too.
ja: サムソン: アゲートでの一件、リンの頭をかち割ってやるのを楽しみにしてたんだけどな。

key: CIEL: But it appears petty vengeance will have to wait for another day.
en: CIEL: But it appears petty vengeance will have to wait for another day.
ja: シエル: でも、ささやかな仕返しは、また別の日に持ち越しになりそうですわね。

key: I was all too happy to come up here and beat some sense into Lin for what she did to me back in Agate.
en: I was all too happy to come up here and beat some sense into Lin for what she did to me back in Agate.
ja: アゲートでの一件、リンに一発食らわせてやろうと、喜んでここまで来ましたのに。

key: But it appears petty vengeance will have to wait for another day.
en: But it appears petty vengeance will have to wait for another day.
ja: でも、ささやかな仕返しは、また別の日に持ち越しになりそうですわね。

key: I was hoping we would at least find someone here...
en: I was hoping we would at least find someone here...
ja: せめて誰か、ここで見つかればと思っていましたのに……

key: SAMSON: Almost thought I did see a girl with dark hair when we first got here, but it must've been a trick of the light.
en: SAMSON: Almost thought I did see a girl with dark hair when we first got here, but it must've been a trick of the light.
ja: サムソン: ここに来たばっかりのとき、黒髪の女の姿が見えた気がしたんだけどな、光のいたずらだったんだろうな。

key: Been searching around for too long already and there's nothing-doing.
en: Been searching around for too long already and there's nothing-doing.
ja: もうずいぶん長いこと探し回ってるが、何の収穫もねえ。

key: We were just about to throw in the towel when you arrived.
en: We were just about to throw in the towel when you arrived.
ja: お前が来たとき、ちょうどあきらめかけてたところだったんだ。

key: CIEL: You're certainly welcome to stay and admire the pretty space rock if you're so inclined, but adjust your expectations accordingly.
en: CIEL: You're certainly welcome to stay and admire the pretty space rock if you're so inclined, but adjust your expectations accordingly.
ja: シエル: よろしければ、この美しい宇宙の岩を眺めていってくださって構いませんけれど、期待はそれなりに抑えておいてくださいまし。

key: SAMSON: The actual meteor's still gotta be out there somewhere.
en: SAMSON: The actual meteor's still gotta be out there somewhere.
ja: サムソン: 本物のメテオは、まだどこかにあるはずだ。

key: Best we save our energy for when it actually comes to.
en: Best we save our energy for when it actually comes to.
ja: そのときのために、力は取っておいた方がいいだろうな。

key: CIEL: Ta-ta for the time.
en: CIEL: Ta-ta for the time.
ja: シエル: では、また今度。

key: The meteor glows with protective energy.
en: The meteor glows with protective energy.
ja: メテオが、守りのエネルギーで輝いている。

key: Deoxys resonated with the meteor's energy!
en: Deoxys resonated with the meteor's energy!
ja: デオキシスが、メテオのエネルギーと共鳴した!

key: DEOXYS: Xqwyggyqxxi~
en: DEOXYS: Xqwyggyqxxi~
ja: デオキシス: Xqwyggyqxxi～

key: Xxxkwyqqqywygixi!!!
en: Xxxkwyqqqywygixi!!!
ja: Xxxkwyqqqywygixi!!!

key: DEOXYS: Xyqwikyxyxyiwqwyx!!!
en: DEOXYS: Xyqwikyxyxyiwqwyx!!!
ja: デオキシス: Xyqwikyxyxyiwqwyx!!!

key: The meteor glows with balanced energy.
en: The meteor glows with balanced energy.
ja: メテオが、均衡のエネルギーで輝いている。

key: The meteor glows with destructive energy.
en: The meteor glows with destructive energy.
ja: メテオが、破壊のエネルギーで輝いている。

key: The meteor glows with an agile energy.
en: The meteor glows with an agile energy.
ja: メテオが、俊敏なエネルギーで輝いている。

key: ???: Once upon a time, a belt of meteors swept across the universe.
en: ???: Once upon a time, a belt of meteors swept across the universe.
ja: ???: 昔々、宇宙をメテオの帯が駆け抜けていった。

key: But one day, one of those little meteors became a shooting star instead.
en: But one day, one of those little meteors became a shooting star instead.
ja: でもある日、その小さなメテオのひとつが、流れ星になった。

key: And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
en: And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
ja: そして、その姿は世界から永遠に消えてしまったけれど、その小さなメテオが何をしたか知っている?

key: It lived happily ever after,
en: It lived happily ever after,
ja: それは、ずっと幸せに暮らした――

key: In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments.
en: In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments.
ja: 最後の瞬間にもたらした喜びと、触れた心と、生んだ笑顔の中で。

key: And it seems the same will be true for my little meteorite.
en: And it seems the same will be true for my little meteorite.
ja: そして、わたしの小さな流星のかけらにも、同じことが言えるみたい。

key: I was always still looking out for her.
en: I was always still looking out for her.
ja: わたしはずっと、あの子のことを見守っていた。

key: Still there, from his heart.
en: Still there, from his heart.
ja: 彼の心の中に、今もまだいる。

key: That pendant was mine once.
en: That pendant was mine once.
ja: あのペンダントは、かつてわたしのものだった。

key: It let me shine bright enough to save his home.
en: It let me shine bright enough to save his home.
ja: それのおかげで、わたしは彼の故郷を救えるほど、明るく輝けた。

key: And just like her, everyone forgot about it.
en: And just like her, everyone forgot about it.
ja: そして、あの子と同じように、みんなそれのことを忘れてしまった。

key: Now it's let her save the ones she cared about,
en: Now it's let her save the ones she cared about,
ja: 今は、それがあの子を、大切な人たちを救わせてくれている、

key: And she, too, is fading away.
en: And she, too, is fading away.
ja: そして、あの子もまた、消えかけている。

key: And she, too, is dimming.
en: And she, too, is dimming.
ja: そして、あの子もまた、薄れかけている。

key: You've also been touched by too much of its power.
en: You've also been touched by too much of its power.
ja: あなたも、その力に触れすぎてしまったのね。

key: After all, you can see me.
en: After all, you can see me.
ja: だって、あなたにはわたしが見えているもの。

key: From carrying it, and no doubt, from your battle with its source.
en: From carrying it, and no doubt, from your battle with its source.
ja: それを持ち歩いたことから、そして間違いなく、その源との戦いから。

key: But I should have been let go of a long time ago.
en: But I should have been let go of a long time ago.
ja: でも、わたしはとっくの昔に、手放されているべきだった。

key: Some people are just meant to be like that--
en: Some people are just meant to be like that--
ja: そういう運命の人も、いるものよ――

key: Fireworks who shine bright, light up the lives of everyone around them, and then go out as quickly as they came, fading into the night sky.
en: Fireworks who shine bright, light up the lives of everyone around them, and then go out as quickly as they came, fading into the night sky.
ja: 明るく輝いて、周りのみんなの人生を照らして、来たときと同じくらい早く消えていく、夜空に溶けていく花火のような。

key: Let me go out with a bang.
en: Let me go out with a bang.
ja: 最後は、派手に散らせてちょうだい。

key: Would you share in one last delusion with me?
en: Would you share in one last delusion with me?
ja: 最後にひとつ、わたしの妄想に付き合ってくれるかしら?

key: I had to be let go eventually. This is for the best.
en: I had to be let go eventually. This is for the best.
ja: いずれ手放されるべきだったの。これでよかったのよ。

key: ZINA: Thank you.
en: ZINA: Thank you.
ja: ジーナ: ありがとう。

key: ZINA: Your way forward is still hidden.
en: ZINA: Your way forward is still hidden.
ja: ジーナ: あなたの進む道は、まだ隠されている。

key: My little meteorite is struggling.
en: My little meteorite is struggling.
ja: わたしの小さな流星のかけらは、もがいている。

key: Not just Dreamsick, but poisoned by the corruption that girl left behind,
en: Not just Dreamsick, but poisoned by the corruption that girl left behind,
ja: ドリームシックだけじゃなく、あの子が残していったけがれにもむしばまれている、

key: Struggling ever more to control her sparks.
en: Struggling ever more to control her sparks.
ja: 自分の輝きを制御しようと、ますますもがいている。

key: She's trying to hide it--
en: She's trying to hide it--
ja: あの子はそれを隠そうとしている――

key: Trying to save everyone, even now, even from herself,
en: Trying to save everyone, even now, even from herself,
ja: 今も、自分自身からさえも、みんなを救おうとしている、

key: And even if it means her own complete erasure.
en: And even if it means her own complete erasure.
ja: たとえそれが、自分自身の完全な消滅を意味するとしても。

key: I do not wish her to share my fate.
en: I do not wish her to share my fate.
ja: あの子に、わたしと同じ運命をたどってほしくない。

key: But perhaps mine can spare her.
en: But perhaps mine can spare her.
ja: でも、わたしの運命が、あの子を救えるかもしれない。

key: The creature which I sealed away so that the keepers' descendant couldn't use it himself--
en: The creature which I sealed away so that the keepers' descendant couldn't use it himself--
ja: 守護者の子孫自身が使えないよう、わたしが封じた生き物――

key: You will find it deep in Byxbysion.
en: You will find it deep in Byxbysion.
ja: ビクスビジョンの奥深くで見つかるはずよ。

key: That girl has grown scared.
en: That girl has grown scared.
ja: あの子は怖がるようになった。

key: More scared than she was even to begin with.
en: More scared than she was even to begin with.
ja: 最初よりも、ずっと怖がるようになった。

key: She is hiding.
en: She is hiding.
ja: あの子は隠れている。

key: Using the power of her own corrupted creature, she buries her creations out of sight now.
en: Using the power of her own corrupted creature, she buries her creations out of sight now.
ja: 自分のけがれた生き物の力を使って、今では自分の創造物を人目につかないところに埋めている。

key: But still she builds.
en: But still she builds.
ja: それでも、あの子は作り続けている。

key: Perhaps that creature will find them...
en: Perhaps that creature will find them...
ja: きっと、あの生き物が見つけ出してくれるはず……

key: I sealed it away long ago, deep within Byxbysion.
en: I sealed it away long ago, deep within Byxbysion.
ja: わたしはずっと昔、それをビクスビジョンの奥深くに封じた。

key: That is your key.
en: That is your key.
ja: それが、あなたの鍵よ。

key: Lock up when you're done.
en: Lock up when you're done.
ja: 終わったら、鍵を閉めておいてね。

key: Shut the window, the curtains--
en: Shut the window, the curtains--
ja: 窓を閉めて、カーテンを引いて――

key: And whisper good night.
en: And whisper good night.
ja: そして、おやすみとささやいて。

key: Good night, little meteorite.
en: Good night, little meteorite.
ja: おやすみ、小さな流星のかけら。

key: I'll watch over you tomorrow, too.
en: I'll watch over you tomorrow, too.
ja: 明日も、あなたを見守っているから。

key: ???: When you're ready.
en: ???: When you're ready.
ja: ???: 準備ができたときに。

key: Or when you're prepared to accept not being so.
en: Or when you're prepared to accept not being so.
ja: あるいは、そうではないことを受け入れる覚悟ができたときに。

key: LIN: wow, this was kind of a lame time, huh
en: LIN: wow, this was kind of a lame time, huh
ja: リン: うわー、なんか微妙な展開だったね

key: you just kinda walk in???
en: you just kinda walk in???
ja: 普通に歩いて入ってくるだけとか???

key: and deoxys is just there????
en: and deoxys is just there????
ja: しかもデオキシスが普通にそこにいるだけとか????

key: that's the most basic fetch quest I could imagine.
en: that's the most basic fetch quest I could imagine.
ja: 考えられる中で一番ベーシックなお使いクエストじゃん。

key: whose fault is that???
en: whose fault is that???
ja: それって誰のせい???

key: anyway, there's probably some other game you can play or something if you really want more deoxys.
en: anyway, there's probably some other game you can play or something if you really want more deoxys.
ja: まあとにかく、もっとデオキシスが欲しいなら、たぶん他にも遊べるゲームがあるんじゃない。

key: interested?
en: interested?
ja: 興味ある?

key: LIN: okay, have fun, try not to trip and fall into hoenn or something!!!
en: LIN: okay, have fun, try not to trip and fall into hoenn or something!!!
ja: リン: オッケー、楽しんでね、つまずいてホウエンとかに落っこちないようにね!!!

key: LIN: ....... wait.
en: LIN: ....... wait.
ja: リン: …………待って。

key: that didn't work.
en: that didn't work.
ja: うまくいかなかった。

key: ok so
en: ok so
ja: えっとね

key: what's SUPPOSED to happen
en: what's SUPPOSED to happen
ja: 本当はこうなるはずだったの

key: is you say yes and i send you to the rejuv website
en: is you say yes and i send you to the rejuv website
ja: あんたが「はい」って言って、あたしがRejuvenationのサイトに送るの

key: and then you go "omg Lin you're so cool i want to be your best friend"
en: and then you go "omg Lin you're so cool i want to be your best friend"
ja: そしたらあんたが「うわ、リンってマジすごい、親友になりたい」って言う

key: but it didn't work!!!!!!
en: but it didn't work!!!!!!
ja: なのに、うまくいかなかった!!!!!!

key: so you're just going to have to find it yourself.
en: so you're just going to have to find it yourself.
ja: だから、自分で探すしかないってわけ。

key: LIN: also get a better computer.
en: LIN: also get a better computer.
ja: リン: あと、もっとマシなパソコン買いな。

key: LIN: your loss.
en: LIN: your loss.
ja: リン: あんたの損だよ。

key: ANNA: Hi \PN~
en: ANNA: Hi \PN~
ja: アンナ: やあ、\PN～

key: I think I'm on to her~
en: I think I'm on to her~
ja: あの子の手がかり、つかめてきたと思うんだ～

key: And once I find her, things can finally get REALLY fun!
en: And once I find her, things can finally get REALLY fun!
ja: そして見つけたら、ついに本当に楽しくなるよ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
